rules.name: Focal Point
rules.description: Friendly Daemon units which arrive via Deep Strike do not Scatter and arrive on target if they arrive within 12” of this model. In addition, friendly Daemon units within 12” of this model may re-roll all Leadership Tests for Pinning, Panic and Casting Psychic powers.

rules.name: Sinistrious Hand
rules.description: If any wounds allocated from attacks made by this model would slay an enemy model during the Combat Phase. This unit Heals 1 wound at the end of the phase.

rules.name: Spoilpox Scribbler
rules.description: A unit with this upgrade exchanges its Bale Sword for a Close Combat Weapon. The Spoilpox Scribbler and any attached unit gains the Zealot special rules. The unit loses the Psyker (1) special rules.

rules.name: Sloppity Bilepiper
rules.description: A unit with this upgrade exchanges its Bale Sword for a Close Combat Weapon. The Sloppity Bilepiper and any attached unit gains the Crusader special rules. The unit loses the Psyker (1) special rules.

rules.name: Burning Rage
rules.description: When Skarbrand suffers the effects of Frenzy, he gains +3 additional bonus Attacks in the Combat Phase on the turn he completes a charge. In addition, while Skarbrand is under the effects of Frenzy he gains the Macro special rule on all Melee weapons he is equipped with.

rules.name: Fanged Maw
rules.description: At Initiative Step 1 of a Combat in the Combat Phase that this unit is engaged in, you may select a single enemy model with 4 or less wounds. The model must roll a D6. If the result is lower than the models unmodified Strength (S) characteristic, nothing happens. If the result is higher, the model is slain and removed from play.

rules.name: Deluge of Nurgle
rules.description: All terrain within 12” of Rotigus Rain Father are considered Difficult Terrain, including open terrain. In addition, each time Rotigus casts a Psychic Power, all units on the Battlefield that do not have the Nurgle Keyword suffer -1 to their Leadership (LD) characteristic.

rules.name: Challenge of the Duel
rules.description: In the Combat Phase, Shelaxi Hellbane can issue a challenge. A single enemy model may accept the challenge. If so, move these models to be within 1” of each other. During the combat, wounds inflicted by Shelaxi and the model which accepts the challenge may only allocate wounds to each other from their attacks. While in a Challenge, Shelaxi gains the Preferred Enemy special rule. If no Challenge is accepted, Shelaxi gains the Hit & Run special rule.

rules.name: Cloak of Constrictions
rules.description: At Initiative step 9 of the Combat Phase, you may select a single enemy model within 3” to be constricted. That unit suffers -1 to its Initiative (I) characteristic this Combat Phase.

rules.name: Foresight
rules.description: While this unit is alive and, on the battlefield, you may re-roll any 2 dice rolls each battle round.

rules.name: Past and Future at once
rules.description: Kairos Fateweaver and any attached unit may always set to Overwatch, even if he made a Shooting Attack in the Shooting Phase. In addition, while Kairos Fateweaver is your Warlord, you may may declare your Warp Surge result at the beginning of each Battle Round instead of rolling.

rules.name: Shadow form
rules.description: Instead of Setting to Overwatch, this unit may set to become Shadow. At the end of your opponent’s Charge phase, if no enemy units are within 3” of this model, you may remove it from the battlefield and place it into ongoing reserves.

rules.name: The First Favoured
rules.description: If Be’lakor is your Warlord, at the start of each Battle Round, you may opt to exchange your current Mark (see wargear) for a Different Mark of Chaos.

rules.name: Prince of the Ruinstorm
rules.description: during deployment, you may place down 1 Rift Marker (See Incursion Rite of War) anywhere on the battlefield.

rules.name: Whispers of Madness
rules.description: Enemy units within 3” of Samus while he is your Warlord, halve their Leadership (LD) characteristic. This stacks with the effects of the Fear (x) special rule.

rules.name: The Warfiend
rules.description: If this unit is your Warlord, it and any attached unit always hits on a 3+ in the Combat Phase unless the target units Weapon Skill (WS) characteristic is double this units.

rules.name: Tide of Flesh
rules.description: When this unit makes a Regeneration roll (see Regeneration Special rule), this unit may roll 2D6.

rules.name: Worthy Trophies
rules.description: If Skulltaker is your Warlord, he and any attached unit gain the Preferred Enemy (Infantry) special rule. In addition, each time an enemy unit is slain as a result of wounds inflicted by Skulltaker, rolls a D6. On a 1, Skulltaker does not find a worthy skull and nothing happens. On a 6, a worthy Trophy is found and Skulltaker and his attached unit gain the Preferred Enemy special rule for the rest of the game.

rules.name: Tally of Pestilence
rules.description: If this unit is your Warlord, Epidemius and any attached unit gain the Arcing (6+) special rule. In addition, they gain the Shred special rule on all weapons they are equipped with that have the Poison (x) special rule.

rules.name: Graceful Acrobatics
rules.description: While this unit is within 3” of an enemy unit it gains a 4+ Invulnerable save.

rules.name: The Eternal Dance
rules.description: This units Movement (M) characteristic can never be modified negatively.

rules.name: The Master of Illusions
rules.description: This unit may opt to join and attach enemy units that do not already have an attached Character model. All of the normal rules for being attached apply and when targeted for attacks, the enemy unit may allocate attacks to the Changeling who may take saves as normal. An enemy unit that the Changeling is attached to suffers -1 to its Weapon Skill (WS), Ballistic Skill (BS), Attacks (A), Initiative (I), and Leadership (LD) characteristics. In addition, the enemy unit cannot contest or control objectives. While attached, the Changeling cannot attack the attached unit in any phase and must leave the attached unit before it can declare movements or charges.

rules.name: Splitting Horrors
rules.description: At the end of each Shooting Phase or Combat Phase, add 2 Blue Horror models to the unit for each Pink Horror model from the unit that was slain and removed from play that phase. Add 1 Brimstone Horror to the unit for each Blue Horror slain and removed from play that phase. Newly placed models must be placed within coherency of a model that was not added to the unit that phase. If all models in the unit were slain in the phase, you do not place any Blue or Brimstone Horrors on the board.

rules.name: Gift of Power
rules.description: In the Shooting Phase, instead of making a shooting attack, you can select a single Psyker on the Battlefield within 18” of this model. That unit immediately suffers a Peril of the Warp.

rules.name: Swallow Energy
rules.description: Instead of Casting a Psychic Power, this unit may attempt to absorb energy instead. Make a Leadership test. If the test is passed, this unit and any attached unit gain +1 to their Strength (S) characteristic. On a fail, the unit suffers a Peril of the Warp.

rules.name: Roar of Hunter
rules.description: At the beginning of the Combat Phase, roll 3D6. If the total result is higher than an engaged units Leadership (LD) characteristic, they suffer -1 to their Initiative (I) characteristic until the end of the Phase.

rules.name: Gardner of Nurgle
rules.description: Once per game, in the Movement phase instead of performing a Movement action, Horticulus may spawn a Nexus of Power within 3” of him. This must be placed more than 9” away from any enemy models.

rules.name: Arcane Magic Unleashed
rules.description: This unit knows all Psychic Powers from all armies on the Battlefield if they have their own Psychic Discipline

rules.name: Soporific Musk
rules.description: Enemy Infantry, Bike, Jetbike, Cavalry, Beast, and Monster type units engaged in Combat with this unit suffer -1 to the Weapon Skill (WS) characteristic.

rules.name: Exalted Chariot
rules.description: An Exalted Chariot increases its Hammer of Wrath (1) special rule to Hammer of Wrath (2).

sharedRules.name: Warp Surge
sharedRules.description:
At the start of each Battle round, roll 2D6 and consult the chart below. If your Army includes at least 1 unit with the Greater Daemon keyword. After rolling on the Warp Surge table, you may modify the result by 1. Apply any benefits listed as affecting friendly units with this special rule.
2. Flickering tides: All Daemon units in your army worsen their Invulnerable Saves by 1 until the end of the battle round.
3. Unexpected tide: immediately summon 1 Flesh Hounds, Fiends of Slaanesh, Beast of Nurgle or Screamers of Tzeentch unit anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 9" of a friendly Daemon character. The summoned unit arrives Deep Strike and arrives automatically. This result has no effect if you have no units with the Character special rule alive and on the Battlefield.
4. Anchoring Tide: All Daemon units improve their Invulnerable saves by 1 until the end of the battle round (to a max of 3+).
5. Strengthening Tide: All Daemon units gain +1 to their Strength (S) characteristic until the end of the battle round.
6. Dark Prince Ascendant: All Daemon units gain +1 to their Movement (M) characteristic in addition until the end of the round. In addition, all Slaanesh Daemon units gain the Fleet special rule until the end of the Battle Round.
7. Plague Father Ascendant: All Daemon units gain +1 to their Toughness (T) characteristic until the end of the battle round. All Nurgle Daemon units immediately Heal 1 lost wound when this result is rolled.
8. Blood God Ascendant: All Daemon units gain +1 to their Attacks (A) characteristic until the end of the battle round. All Khorne Daemon units gain +1 to their Weapon Skill (WS) characteristic until the end of the battle round.
9. Changer of Fate Ascendant: All Daemon gain +1 to their Ballistic Skill (BS) characteristic until the end of the phase. All Tzeentch Daemon units gain the Linked special rule on each Ranged & Psychic weapons they are equipped with until the end of the phase.
10. Hellfire Rain: Immediately make D3 attacks anywhere on the board with a strength 6, AP4, Blast (Large) weapon that hits on a 4+.
11. Warp Rift: Immediately select 1 Daemon unit on the battlefield. Remove it from play and place it back on the board anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" away from any enemy models.
12. Great Incursion: Immediately summon 1 Bloodletter, Daemonettes, Plague Bearer or Pink Horror unit anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 9" of a friendly Daemon character. The summoned unit arrives via Deep Strike and arrives automatically. This result has no effect if you have no units with the Character special rule alive and on the Battlefield.

sharedRules.name: Daemonic Instability
sharedRules.description: When a unit with this special rule fails a Panic test, instead of falling back the unit begins to flicker out of existence. Instead of Falling Back, the unit suffers D3 wounds with no saves of any kind which cannot be ignored. The unit then continues as normal as if it passed the Panic test.

sharedRules.name: Greater Daemon
sharedRules.description: A unit with this special rule gains the Greater Daemon Keyword. A unit with this special rule has a 4+ Invulnerable save and gains the Battle-Hardened special rule.

sharedRules.name: Sacrificial
sharedRules.description: When attempting to cast a Psychic Power or Psychic Weapon, a model equipped with this weapon may inflict 1 wound to itself. After allocating the wound and rolling to see if its ignored, the model may re-roll 1 dice when attempting to cast a Psychic Power.

sharedRules.name: Morphing Form
sharedRules.description: The stats of this weapon are equal to one weapon on an enemy model whose unit is engaged with this unit.

sharedRules.name: Slime Trail of Nurgle
sharedRules.description: This unit has +1 to the dice roll when rolling for Sweeping Advances.

rules.name: Warp Armour
rules.description: Armour forged within the immaterial realm. It confers a 3+ Armour save.

rules.name: Instruments of Chaos
rules.description: A unit that includes a model equipped with this wargear gains the Sprint (1) special rule.

rules.name: Daemonic Banner
rules.description: A unit which includes a model equipped with this wargear counts as scoring 1 additional wound for the purposes of combat resolution. In addition, once per game, a unit that includes a model with this wargear may invoke it to return D3 slain models back to the unit in coherency. Further, friendly units which arrive from Deep Strike within 12” of a model equipped with this wargear do not scatter.

rules.name: Daemonic Chariot
rules.description: A unit with the Daemonic Chariot becomes a Cavalry type unit. In addition, it gains +2 to its Toughness (T), Attacks (A) and Wounds (W) characteristics.

rules.name: Warp Scaled Hide
rules.description: Shifting warp powered scales. It a 4+ Armour save.

rules.name: Brass Armour
rules.description: Sturdy Brass Armour which comes in many forms. It confers a 4+ Armour Save and the Adamantium Will special rule.

rules.name: Wings
rules.description: A model with this wargear increases their Movement (M) characteristic to 12”. It gains the Hammer of Wrath (1), Fly and Deep strike special rules.

rules.name: Daemonic Steed
rules.description: A unit that is equipped with a Daemonic Steed becomes a Cavalry type unit. In addition, it gains +1 Strength (S), Toughness (T) and Wounds (W) Characteristics.

rules.name: The Mark of Chaos Undivided
rules.description:
• A unit with this Mark gains the Undivided Keyword and may only be joined by units with the Undivided, Khorne, Tzeentch, Nurgle or Slaanesh keywords.
• A unit with this Mark gains the Fear (1) special rule. If the unit already has the Fear (x) special rule, increase the value of X by 1.
• In addition, if the unit would fail a Panic test, instead of Falling Back, the unit takes D3 wounds with no saves or mitigation rolls allowed.
• A unit with this wargear gains access to the Lore of Slaanesh, Nurgle and Tzeentch Psychic Powers if they have the Psyker (x) special rule.

rules.name: The Mark of Khorne
rules.description:
• A unit with this Mark gains the Khorne Keyword and may only join or be joined by units with the Khorne or Undivided Keywords.
• A unit with this mark gains the Furious Charge special rule. If the unit already has the Furious Charge special rule it gains +1 to its Attack (A) characteristic.
• A unit with the Psyker (x) special rule may not purchase this wargear.

rules.name: The Mark of Nurgle
rules.description:
• A unit with this Mark gains the Nurgle Keyword and may only join or be joined by units with the Nurgle or Undivided Keywords.
• A unit with this mark gains the Feel no Pain (5+) special rule. If the unit does not have a Wounds (W) characteristic, it instead always gains the Benefits of Heavy Cover.
• A unit with this wargear gains access to the Lore of Nurgle Psychic Powers if they have the Psyker (x) special rule.

rules.name: The Mark of Slaanesh
rules.description:
• A unit with this Mark gains the Slaanesh Keyword and may only join or be joined by units with the Slaanesh or Undivided Keywords.
• A unit with this mark gains +1 to their Initiative (I) characteristic.
• A unit with this Mark gains the Sudden Strike special rule.
• A unit with this wargear gains access to the Lore of Slaanesh Psychic Powers if they have the Psyker (x) special rule.

rules.name: The Mark of Tzeentch
rules.description:
• A unit with this Mark gains the Tzeentch Keyword and may only join or be joined by units with the Tzeentch or Undivided Keywords.
• A unit with this mark gains +1 to their Invulnerable saves (to a max of 3+). If they do not have an Invulnerable save, they gain a 6+ Invulnerable save.
• In addition, A unit with this wargear and the Psyker (x) special rule may re-roll 1 dice when making a Psychic Test.
• A unit with this wargear gains access to the Tzeentch Psychic Powers if they have the Psyker (x) special rule.

rules.name: The Impossible Robe
rules.description: A model with this Relic can re-roll Invulnerable Save rolls of 1.

rules.name: Rift Bringer
rules.description: If your army includes a model with this wargear, during deployment, you may place down 1 Rift Marker (See Incursion Rite of War) anywhere on the battlefield.

rules.name: Warp Reserve
rules.description: The first time a model with this wargear is slain and removed from play. Place it in reserves instead with D3 Wounds remaining. It may arrive at the start of your next turn via the Deep Strike special rule.

rules.name: The Armour of Scorn
rules.description: A model with this Relic gains a 3+ Armour Save. In addition, enemy units with a lower Leadership (LD) characteristic than the relic bearer suffer -1 to Wound Rolls against the Bearer.

rules.name: The Endless Grimoire
rules.description: Once per game, a model with this relic can attempt to cast 1 Psycic Power or Psychic Weapon from any codex.

rules.name: Rage Incarnate
rules.description:
Friendly Khorne Daemon units attached to a model with this
warlord trait or within 12” of a Greater Daemon model with this Warlord trait gain the Frenzy special rule.

rules.name: Bewitching Aura
rules.description: At the start of each Combat Phase, select a single enemy model within 3” of the model with this Warlord trait. The target unit must make a Leadership (LD) test. On a pass, nothing happens. On a fail, the unit is reduced to Initiative (I) 1 this Combat Phase.

rules.name: Blessed with Corpulence
rules.description: A model with this Warlord trait increases its Wounds (W) characteristic by 1.

rules.name: Born of Sorcery
rules.description: When a model with this Warlord trait would suffer a Perils of the Warp, do not roll on the table. The result is always treated as if you rolled 5.

rules.name: Celerity of Slaanesh
rules.description: A model with this Warlord Trait increases its Movement (M) characteristic by 6”.

rules.name: Devastating Blow
rules.description:
Any to wound roll of an unmodified 6 with a melee weapon this
Warlord is equipped with is treated as an Instant Death Wound even if
the Strength of the attackers weapon is not double the Toughness (T) characteristic of the target.

rules.name: Lorekeeper of Tzeentch
rules.description:
A model with this Warlord trait may roll 3D6 when attempting to cast a
Psychic Power and take any result they wish. The Warlord gains the Firing Protocols (2) special rule.

rules.name: Oblivious to Pain
rules.description:
A model with this Warlord trait gains the Feel no Pain (6+) special
rule and may re-roll Regeneration rolls of 1.

rules.name: Plaguefly Hive
rules.description:
Enemy units engaged in combat with a model with this Warlord trait
suffer -1 to their Initiative (I) and Weapon Skill (WS)
characteristics.

rules.name: Quicksilver Duellist
rules.description: A Warlord with this trait gains the Preferred Enemy (Infantry) special rule and Precision Hits special on all Melee weapons it is equipped with.

rules.name: Virulent Touch
rules.description: A model with this Warlord trait gains the Shred special rule on any weapons it is equipped with that have the Poison (x) special rule.

rules.name: Warp Tether
rules.description: Friendly Daemon units wholly within 12” of a model with this Warlord trait can re-roll failed Pinning and Panic tests.

rules.name: Exalted Daemon
rules.description: The unit gains +1 to its Weapon Skill (WS), Strength (S), Toughness (T), Attacks (A), and Leadership (LD) characteristic.

rules.name: Shining Aegis
rules.description: This unit gains a 4+ Armour save. In addition, enemy units have -1 to hit this unit in the Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Disc
rules.description: A model equipped with a Disc increases its Movement (M) characteristic to 13” (This includes the bonus from the Daemon special rule) and gains the Hammer of Wrath (1) & Fly special rule.

rules.name: Blades of Putrefaction (Psychic Power)
rules.description: When this power is cast, the Psyker and any attached unit gain the Poison (4+) special rule on all Melee weapons they are equipped with until the start of your next Shooting Phase. If an effected model is equipped with a Melee type weapon with the Poison (x) special rule, it becomes Poison (2+) instead.

rules.name: Nurgles Rot (Psychic Power)
rules.description: When this power is cast, target 1 enemy unit within 12” of the Psyker. The target unit takes 2D6, Strength 2, AP-, automatic hits.

rules.name: Fleshy Abundance (Psychic Power)
rules.description: When this power is cast, the Psyker or 1 friendly model within 24” Heals 1 lost Wound.

rules.name: Curse of the Leper (Psychic Power)
rules.description: When this power is cast, target 1 enemy unit within 18” of the Psyker. The target unit suffers -1 to its Strength (S) & Toughness (T) characteristic until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Hysterical Frenzy (Psychic Power)
rules.description: When this power is cast, the Psyker and any attached unit gain the Arcing (6+) special rule on all melee weapons they are equipped with until the start of your next Shooting Phase. If the unit already has Arcing (x), improve Arcing (x) by 1 to a max of 3+.

rules.name: Delightful Agonies (Psychic Power)
rules.description: When this power is cast, the Psyker and any attached unit gain the Feel no Pain (5+) special rule until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Symphony of Pain (Psychic Power)
rules.description: When this power is cast, target 1 enemy unit within 18” of the Psyker. The target unit suffers -1 to their Weapon Skill (WS) and Ballistic Skill (BS) characteristic until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Boon of Change (Psychic Power)
rules.description:
When this power is cast, the Psyker and their attached unit must pick to gain one of the following until the start of your next Shooting Phase:
• +1 to its Attack (A) characteristic
• +1 to its Strength (S) characteristic.
• +1 to its Initiative (I) characteristic
This power may be cast any number of times by a Psyker in the Shooting Phase if they can cast multiple times.

rules.name: Siphon Magic (Psychic Power)
rules.description: When this power is cast, select 1 enemy unit with the Psyker (x) special rule within 18” of the Psyker. The target unit may not cast any make any Psychic tests to cast Psychic Powers or Psychic Weapons until the start of your next Shooting Phase. In addition, if the target unit has any Psychic Powers or Psychic Weapons in effect, including Force, that effect is negated.

rules.name: Treason of Tzeentch (Psychic Power)
rules.description: When this Power is cast, select 1 enemy unit within 24” of the Psyker that is not an Automata or Drone Type. Immediately make a single Shooting Attack with the targeted unit as if it were your own. The unit is treated as your own for the purposes of determining friendly and enemy targets. The Shooting Attack by the controlled target unit are resolved as Snap Shots. The target unit is treated as an enemy unit immediately after its Shooting Attack is resolved.

rules.name: Baleful Devolution (Psychic Power)
rules.description: When this power is cast, target 1 enemy unit within 18” of the Psyker. The target unit takes 2D6, Strength 4, AP4 Automatic Hits. If any models are slain in the target unit as a result of wounds inflicted by this Psychic Power, immediately summon a Chaos Spawn more than 3” away from the targeted enemy unit.
